title: Imagery / Duo’s personality
slide_intent: Connect character poses to personality because a mascot should express recognizable motivations rather than serve as generic decoration.
strategic_value: Duo’s supportive, persistent and adventurous roles can make Duolingo feel emotionally consistent across encounters.
demonstration: Six Duo expressions and a larger swimming scene accompany copy describing the mascot’s encouragement, persistence, emotions and adventures.
practical_value: Choose a pose that supports the intended character trait or activity.

content_islands.name: Expression family
content_islands.spec: Arrange six Duo poses in two rows of three at upper left.

content_islands.name: Adventure scene
content_islands.spec: Place the large swimming scene beneath the pose grid.

content_islands.name: Personality and contexts
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and supportive, persistent, emotional and adventurous descriptions at right, ending with the drawing-guidance link.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explains Duo as a supporter of learner success and links his personality to his different positions.
reference_purposes.Expression: Multiple poses present the mascot’s emotional and activity range.
reference_purposes.Application: The text distinguishes learner support from adventurous activity outside the app.

ingredient.name: Duo poses
ingredient.role: Express a recognizable supportive and curious character.
ingredient.application: Choose a pose that reflects the stated mood or activity and follow the dedicated drawing guidance.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. Historical characterization. The text’s claims about user effectiveness are source assertions, not measured outcomes established by this manifest.
